reason: Published ga4-mcp entrypoint registers real GA4 Data/Admin read and analysis tools, preview-gated Admin writers, BigQuery dry-run and local support tools.

tools.name: bigquery_dry_run
tools.description: Estimate a fixed GA4 export aggregate query. Execution is CLI-only and may incur costs.
tools.behavior: Builds a fixed SELECT aggregate query against GA4 BigQuery daily export tables and submits a dry-run job to estimate bytes and cost controls; never executes the query.
notes: Optional google-cloud-bigquery dependency is loaded on invocation. Handler accepts fixed parameters/consent/freshness/funnel templates, dates spanning 1–31 days and validated project/dataset/event identifiers; these restrictions are not exposed as schema enums/patterns.

max_bytes must be 1–107374182400. Missing BigQuery dependency returns unsupported. Parameter template requires 1–50 parameter names and an event; funnel template requires 2–7 steps and window_seconds 1–2678400.

tools.name: realtime_report
tools.description: Read uncached realtime rows; inspect completeness. Minute 30–59 needs GA360.
tools.behavior: Constructs a RunRealtimeReportRequest for the supplied fields, minute range, dimension filter and limit; returns uncached rows, quota and completeness without pagination.
notes: Handler enforces 0 <= end_minutes_ago <= start_minutes_ago <= 59; minutes over 29 require GA360. Limit must be 1–250000; these bounds are not in the exposed schema. filter_dict is deliberately an arbitrary JSON object interpreted as a dimension filter.

tools.name: comparison_report
tools.description: Compare named groups and dates within one property, preserving API rows and metadata.
tools.behavior: Validates named comparisons and date ranges, converts inline filters or saved comparison identifiers, and pages a Core runReport while preserving rows, quota and metadata.
notes: comparisons and date_ranges each require 1–4 uniquely named objects; names are nonblank, <=100 characters, and cannot start RESERVED_ or date_range_. Each comparison accepts name and exactly one dimension_filter or comparison; saved comparison must match comparisons/ID. Each date range requires exactly name,start_date,end_date. These are handler restrictions, not schema structure. limit/page_size: 1–250000; max_pages: 1–100.

tools.name: reporting_annotations
tools.description: Read annotations in an explicit date range; annotations do not prove causation.
tools.behavior: Lists alpha reporting-data annotations for the property and explicit UTC date interval.
notes: Unconditionally registered but returns unsupported if the installed Admin client lacks ListReportingDataAnnotationsRequest. Handler requires numeric property ID and explicit YYYY-MM-DD dates spanning 1–366 days, which are not constraints in the exposed schema.

tools.name: change_history
tools.description: Read API-supported changes in UTC dates. Requires edit scope but performs no write.
tools.behavior: Searches account change-history events filtered to the property and explicit UTC date interval, using edit-scope credentials but performing only reads.
notes: Requires analytics.edit scope despite being read-only; returns only selected change metadata, omitting actor identities and resource snapshots. Handler requires numeric account/property IDs and explicit YYYY-MM-DD dates spanning 1–366 days.

tools.name: audience_template
tools.description: Build an offline audience definition. Creating it separately still requires terminal y/N.
tools.behavior: Builds and validates an Audience protobuf definition locally for event participants, numeric event-parameter threshold, or an event sequence; no credentials or GA API calls.
notes: Handler template choices: event_participants, event_parameter_threshold, event_sequence. Membership is 1–540 days; display name 1–100 nonblank characters; events are unique valid event names. Sequence: 2–5 events, window 1–2592000 seconds; simple templates: exactly one event and no window; threshold template requires finite numeric threshold and valid non-eventCount parameter. Schema uses plain strings/numbers without these constraints.

tools.name: benchmarks
tools.description: Return unverified heuristic bands for a vertical, with provenance labels.
tools.behavior: Normalizes a vertical and returns bundled heuristic benchmark bands with provenance labels; no GA API calls.

tools.name: audit
tools.description: Run the full GA4 audit. Returns agent outputs, context, vertical, confidence.
tools.behavior: Orchestrates property context and quality, event taxonomy, funnel, key-event, attribution, property configuration and segment audits, returning their findings and resolved vertical confidence.
notes: Property audit reports data-filter inspection unsupported; attribution audit is skipped when no key events are configured.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Profile the property's live site: vertical, platform, framework, sitemap.
tools.behavior: Obtains website URLs from Admin data streams, fetches public website HTML/robots/sitemaps, infers vertical/platform/framework and saves or reuses property context locally.

tools.name: funnel
tools.description: Build a funnel from an ordered list of event names.
tools.behavior: Validates event steps against a Core report, runs the alpha funnel report, computes step conversion/dropoff rates, and optionally probes postpayment events.
notes: Handler requires 2–10 unique steps, a restriction absent from the input schema. Missing-data validation and optional postpayment diagnostics do not infer sequential ordering.

tools.name: events
tools.description: List distinct events seen on the property.
tools.behavior: Runs a Core report of eventCount by eventName to list events observed in the selected lookback.

tools.name: check_events
tools.description: Check presence of specific events.
tools.behavior: Lists observed event names with a Core report and marks requested event names present or missing.

tools.name: quality
tools.description: Run the data-quality audit (sampling, direct share, not-set share).
tools.behavior: Reads Core reports to assess sampling/completeness, direct traffic and not-set shares, returning findings.

tools.name: conversions
tools.description: Audit key-events (conversions) configuration.
tools.behavior: Reads configured key events (with legacy conversion-event fallback) and checks configuration/capacity; no write.

tools.name: attribution
tools.description: Channel attribution analysis.
tools.behavior: Reads property attribution settings and a Core channel report filtered to the primary event, then computes channel analysis.

tools.name: property_config
tools.description: Property configuration audit.
tools.behavior: Reads property details, retention, streams and custom definitions and produces configuration findings; public data-filter coverage is reported unsupported.
notes: Data filters are a structured unsupported placeholder because this implementation has no public Admin API method for them.

tools.name: user_provided_data_settings
tools.description: Read property UPD configuration; does not establish event consent.
tools.behavior: Reads the alpha property user-provided-data configuration and returns structured settings/status.
notes: Unconditionally registered; returns unsupported when the installed alpha Admin client lacks this method.

tools.name: consent_diagnostics
tools.description: Read UPD/identity settings and list the tag/export evidence still needed.
tools.behavior: Combines user-provided-data and reporting identity settings with a list of missing tag/export evidence; cannot infer consent from configuration.
notes: Installed-client method availability and API errors are returned separately for each setting; tool remains registered.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Generic GA4 runReport.
tools.behavior: Runs a Core report with requested metric/dimension names and relative days, inheriting local cache, paging, quota and PII scrubbing.

tools.name: report_metadata
tools.description: Discover standard/custom report fields; property 0 returns standard fields only.
tools.behavior: Reads Data API metadata for property-specific standard/custom fields, optionally using local cache; property 0 requests standard metadata.

tools.name: conversion_metadata
tools.description: Discover alpha conversion action identifiers and advertising report fields.
tools.behavior: Reads alpha Data metadata including conversion actions/comparisons if the installed client supports ConversionSpec; otherwise returns unsupported.
notes: Registered unconditionally; returns unsupported if installed Data client lacks alpha ConversionSpec.

tools.name: advertising_report
tools.description: Explicit alpha advertising conversion report, separate from key-event reports.
tools.behavior: Builds and pages an alpha runReport with ConversionSpec, explicit dates/actions/attribution model; returns metadata and verifies the Advertising section.
notes: Registered unconditionally; returns unsupported if installed Data client lacks alpha ConversionSpec. Handler accepts only DATA_DRIVEN or LAST_CLICK and conversionActions/ID action identifiers, validates explicit dates and limit 1–250000; not expressed in input schema.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description:
Explicit uncached Core report compatibility read, not a funnel/realtime check.

Uses report dimension-filter semantics; filter_dict takes precedence.
Incompatible selected fields may return an API error.
tools.behavior: Sends an uncached Core checkCompatibility request with selected fields and optional dimension-filter semantics; filter_dict takes precedence over filter_expr.
notes: filter_dict is intentionally arbitrary JSON; handler builds GA dimension filter objects rather than exposing the protobuf schema.

tools.name: propose_admin_write
tools.description: Save one exact write for the user's terminal approval; never execute it.
tools.behavior: Binds and validates an allowlisted Admin operation and arbitrary argument object, persists an expiring immutable local proposal, and returns digest and terminal approval command. Never calls an Admin writer.
notes: Operation must be one of the 15 ga4_approval.OPERATIONS Admin writers; arguments bind to that writer signature rather than an exposed nested model. expires_seconds must be 30–900; sensitive/scrubbed values and proposals exceeding 64 KB are rejected.

tools.name: admin_proposal_status
tools.description: Inspect a proposal's outcome. This tool cannot approve or execute a write.
tools.behavior: Loads and verifies a local proposal and digest, then reports pending, expired, execution-unknown or stored result; never approves or executes.

tools.name: add_key_event
tools.description: Create a key event (conversion). Preview by default; execution also requires interactive y/N approval.
tools.behavior: With confirm=false returns a local dry-run preview. With confirm=true delegates to the underlying Admin writer for key-event creation with capacity checks. The writer requires interactive terminal y/N approval before obtaining write credentials or making API calls; stdio MCP cannot approve it.
notes: confirm=true is not approval: non-TTY stdio returns confirmation_required with applied=false before any API call. Plain definition/parameter strings have no exposed protobuf/enum constraints.

tools.name: property_details

tools.name: run_saved_report
tools.description: Run a saved custom report definition against a property.
tools.behavior: Loads a saved report definition locally and runs a Core report using its metrics/dimensions/filter/paging/date options, overriding relative days when supplied; renders its configured output format.
notes: Output depends on saved default_format and may be JSON, CSV, Markdown, HTML or PDF bytes; optional PDF rendering dependencies may be required.
Source review only; no upstream code, tools/list, authenticated requests or runtime server executed.
Source has no .git; supplied revision is authoritative.

All 47 decorators register unconditionally in scripts/ga4_mcp.py. No optional module adds tools. Optional MCP dependency (mcp>=1.2,<2) is required for ga4-mcp; BigQuery and PDF capability dependencies are optional.

Schemas reconstructed from AST annotations/defaults and full function docstrings. No Context injection, Pydantic input models, Field constraints or parameter docstrings are present. dict[str,Any] remains arbitrary object; dict[str,str] has string additionalProperties. Runtime FastMCP/Pydantic presentation details may vary with installed versions.
Admin writer tools default to previews; the non-TTY MCP transport cannot satisfy interactive terminal approval. Local proposal support deliberately has no MCP execution tool.
Auth-guarded tools apply a read budget, PII scrubbing and structured auth/API/confirmation error handling; cache and support file writes may accompany read operations.

review.method: Root independently compared all 47 signatures, defaults, required sets and full descriptions with AST; reviewed core dispatch, read-only previews, terminal approval and GA4 BigQuery dry-run behavior.
